+
+The separate `mhd_cuda_fp32` target uses float for every high-volume device
+state, normal/area/volume/basis, reconstruction, flux, gravity, RK update,
+cleaning, and reduction. Host time and geometry construction, boundary coordinate
+axes and phase lookup remain double. The map values are float. Snapshots and
+probes are converted back to the same host output format; this does not restore
+lost device precision. `build_fp32.py` generates the separate sources with
+explicit float constants and sqrtf/powf/fabsf/copysignf, and records the frozen
+parent and generated hashes. It is an explicit regeneration step, not a make
+dependency. `validate_fp32.py` compares saved FP64 runs with FP32 reruns,
+including PN-only incident flux, fallback counts, and divergence diagnostics.
+Precision agreement is a separate requirement from spatial or flux-scheme
+convergence.
+
+`kernel_benchmark_fp32 config.cfg` and its FP64 equivalent initialize the same
+problem, then time five calls to each directional flux kernel with CUDA events.
+They do not evolve the wind. These are separate executables so profiling never
+modifies a production solver. Shared GPU activity can increase measured time;
+the result is useful as an upper bound for short-kernel coordination.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Generate a separate optional cone variant from the verified FP32 sources."""
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+ROOT = HERE.parents[1]
+script = ROOT / "scripts/build_cme_cpu.py"
+spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("controlled_cpu_cones", script)
+module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+
+header = module.extend((HERE / "reference_host.hpp").read_text())
+(HERE / "reference_host_cme.hpp").write_text(header)
+
+physics = (HERE / "device_physics_fp32.cuh").read_text()
+physics = physics.replace("int nt,nl,na,angular,empty;",
+                          "int nt,nl,na,angular,empty,ncones;\n  const double *cones;")
+cone_function = r'''
+// Cone timing and inertial geometry are boundary-only double calculations.
+// Primitive updates remain float. No magnetic flux-rope content is imposed.
+__device__ double cone_ramp(double x){x=x<0?0:(x>1?1:x);double s=sin(1.57079632679489661923*x);return s*s;}
+__device__ void cone_sample(double day,double lon,double lat,float*b){
+  double best=0;const double*selected=nullptr;
+  for(int n=0;n<BD.ncones;++n){const double*z=BD.cones+n*8;
+    if(day<=z[0]||day>=z[1])continue;
+    double cosine=sin(lat)*sin(z[3])+cos(lat)*cos(z[3])*cos(lon-z[2]);
+    double angle=acos(cosine<-1?-1:(cosine>1?1:cosine));if(angle>=z[4])continue;
+    double phase=(day-z[0])/(z[1]-z[0]);
+    double temporal=cone_ramp((phase<1-phase?phase:1-phase)/.1);
+    double angular=cone_ramp((1-angle/z[4])/.1),w=temporal*angular;
+    if(w>=best){best=w;selected=z;}
+  }
+  if(selected){float w=(float)best;
+    b[0]+=((float)selected[5]-b[0])*w;
+    b[1]*=1.f+((float)selected[6]-1.f)*w;
+    b[3]*=1.f+((float)selected[7]-1.f)*w;
+  }
+}
+'''
+needle = "__device__ DS analytic"
+assert physics.count(needle) == 1
+physics = physics.replace(needle, cone_function + "\n" + needle)
+needle = "boundary_sample(day-lag,ph,1.57079632679489661923-th,b);"
+assert physics.count(needle) == 1
+physics = physics.replace(needle, needle + "cone_sample(day-lag,ph,1.57079632679489661923-th,b);")
+(HERE / "device_physics_fp32_cme.cuh").write_text(physics)
+
+source = (HERE / "mhd_cuda_fp32.cu").read_text()
+source = source.replace('"reference_host.hpp"', '"reference_host_cme.hpp"')
+source = source.replace('"device_physics_fp32.cuh"', '"device_physics_fp32_cme.cuh"')
+needle = "CK(cudaMemcpyToSymbol(GD,&grid,sizeof(grid)));"
+assert source.count(needle) == 1
+source = source.replace(needle,
+    "b.ncones=cones.values.size();b.cones=reinterpret_cast<const double*>(memory.upload(cones.values));\n    " + needle)
+source = source.replace("CUDA float32", "CUDA float32 optional cones")
+source = source.replace("Usage: mhd_cuda_fp32 --config", "Usage: mhd_cuda_fp32_cme --config")
+(HERE / "mhd_cuda_fp32_cme.cu").write_text(source)
+
+parents = [HERE / "mhd_cuda_fp32.cu", HERE / "device_physics_fp32.cuh",
+           HERE / "reference_host.hpp", script]
+generated = [HERE / "mhd_cuda_fp32_cme.cu", HERE / "device_physics_fp32_cme.cuh",
+             HERE / "reference_host_cme.hpp"]
+record = {"parent_sources": {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

+          "cone_boundary": "CPU ConeBoundary class reused exactly for host initialization; matching device envelope, inertial fixed axes, largest-weight overlap, later-row tie break"}
